description: We're HARK, space enthusiasts tackling the Space Mission Game challenge. We love mission design, strategy, and turning real aerospace concepts into playable experiences. Our skills include mission planning, systems thinking, game design, prototyping, and space research. Join us if you enjoy strategy, simulation, and solving problems under constraints we build fast and make space decisions fun. We're looking for game developers, UI/UX designers, space science enthusiasts, narrative designers.
